text: つよいんだ　きみって

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ; here it shows the speaker has just realised something. つよいんだ = 'oh, so you're strong'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a noun is a casual way to say 'as for'; here it is tacked on at the end as an afterthought. つよいんだ　きみって = 'you're strong, you are'.
